content:
priya_cs: Quick heads-up on Sable onboarding: security insists on forwarding audit logs into their Splunk instance (cross-account). They want final approach decided today or legal will delay the cutover. Options: S3 replication -> their bucket, or Firehose cross-account. Need input on KMS ownership + rotation, and whether we can support signed S3 replication with server-side encryption using their CMK. @kevin_se @leo_net @sam_am
kevin_se: Short take: S3 replication + cross-account role is the lowest infra friction. We can publish to our bucket and replicate to their bucket using an IAM role in their account we can assume. Downside: replication lag (usually minutes). Firehose gives near-real-time but requires infra in their account and more networking setup.
leo_net: Networking caveat: if we do Firehose with VPC endpoint in our account, we'll need explicit egress rules from their Splunk ingest IPs and possibly a NAT in front. S3 replication avoids additional egress but needs a clear bucket policy.
priya_cs: They also require that all audit objects be encrypted with a CMK that they control OR an agreed shared CMK. If they control the key, we need to be able to put objects encrypted with their key during replication. Is that supported?
kevin_se: Replication with SSE-KMS where the destination key is theirs is possible but requires PutObject with their key and a replication role that has kms:Encrypt permission on their key. We need an explicit grant in their key policy for the replication role ARN. I'll draft both policies.
sam_am: I'll loop in Sable's SecOps to provide the CMK ARN and the Splunk ingest bucket name. Asked them to confirm retention requirements (they want 7 years) which affects lifecycle rules.
oliver_cs: Small business / commercial note: if we push the decision, it triggers an executive renewal risk flag. Not ideal. Can we do a short-lived workaround (deliver a 30-day burn-down export) while teams finalize cross-account flow?
kevin_se: Workaround idea: daily export to a temporary pre-authorized bucket in their account via an exported delivery job (S3 COPY by a scheduled Lambda). Less infra than Firehose, more manual but fast to implement. Still needs cross-account IAM role but fewer moving pieces.
priya_cs: That could buy time. Legal wants written confirmation that PII never leaves customer-owned bucket without encryption + retention controls.
kevin_se: Draft bucket policy snippet for destination bucket (they'll paste into their AWS console):
```json
{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [
    {
      "Sid": "AllowReplicationRole",
      "Effect": "Allow",
      "Principal": {"AWS": "arn:aws:iam::987654321000:role/redwood-replication"},
      "Action": ["s3:PutObject","s3:PutObjectAcl"],
      "Resource": "arn:aws:s3:::sable-audit-archive/*",
      "Condition": {"StringEquals": {"s3:x-amz-server-side-encryption": "aws:kms"}}
    }
  ]
}
```
leo_net: I've sketched a connectivity test for replication path: 1) verify assume-role returns creds 2) put test object to our bucket 3) check replication status on object 4) validate object has SSE-KMS header and correct KMS key id in destination. I'll add the commands to the PR.
deploy-bot: maintenance: planned cutover window reserved 2026-04-02T16:00Z -> 2026-04-02T17:30Z
priya_cs: Action items: Kevin to post final bucket/KMS policy + role ARNs by 1600 PT; Leo to post connectivity test commands and terraform plan; Sam to confirm CMK ARN and retention with Sable SecOps by 1500 PT. If all green, we proceed with replication approach and treat Firehose as fallback.
sam_am: Confirmed meeting with Sable SecOps at 14:00 PT. I'll push the retention answer ASAP.
kevin_se: Pushed draft PR for replication role + example key-grant: https://github.com/redwood-inference/infra/pull/4408 — includes KMS grant snippet and optional rotation tag.
priya_cs: Legal note: I sent the draft data processing appendix to their legal team; awaiting sign-off. If not signed before cutover, we must pause. This is the renewal-risk trigger (flagging execs).
oliver_cs: Understood. I'll prep the renewal-risk tracker and escalation email if needed.
ops-bot: oncall: scheduled watch - @michael_oncall assigned for 2026-04-02 16:00Z
leo_net: PR for routes/replication role + test commands will be posted by EOD. If anyone needs a quick call, I'm free at 15:30 PT.
priya_cs: Thank you all. If Sable signs the DPA and secops approves the CMK grant, we can go green. Otherwise, we'll follow the temporary export workaround and schedule a full-firehose timeline next sprint. :thumbsup:
